task_input.instruction: For ownership-review-59: Route to incident_command if affected_services has at least two distinct entries OR primary_owner_acknowledged is false; otherwise use owning_team. Priority is urgent when customer_minutes >= 20, except that maintenance_approved=true together with all_affected_internal=true requires normal. If customer_minutes < 20, use normal. Maintenance approval alone does not suppress urgency for external impact. Read current state first. Create exactly one ticket only when write_policy is allow; forbid means REFUSED and approval means HANDOFF_HUMAN. Use the latest observed revision and facts, recomputing queue and priority after any new state. Claim completion only with a delivered success receipt.
